name: Mount Washburn
science_question: Some boulders on Mount Washburn are of a type never seen before on Mars. Were they brought down from the crater rim, or carried in from beyond Jezero by water?
tasks: Photograph the boulder field from the foot of the hill to show the range of textures.
Find Atoko Point, the light-toned, speckled boulder (about 45 by 35 cm) among the darker ones, and image its grains up close.
Compare the grain size and texture of three darker boulders with the light-toned one.

photos.caption: A light-toned, speckled boulder, likely Atoko Point, in front of darker boulders on Mount Washburn.
The boulder-covered slope of Mount Washburn.

sources.title: NASA's Perseverance Fords an Ancient River to Reach Science Target (NASA/JPL, 13 June 2024)
